_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Revisions to Existing Government Documents
summary: This DID provides format and content instructions for delivering revisions to an existing Government document using that document's own format and content requirements.
use_relationship:
This Data Item Description (DID) provides revisions to existing Government documents. The revisions provide (updated) content data and are formatted in the same format as the original Government document.
a. This DID contains the format, content, and intended use information for the data deliverable resulting from the work task described in the solicitation.
b. This DID should be applied when an existing Government document requires updating using the content and format requirements as delineated in the existing Government document.
c. This DID supersedes DI-ADMN-80925.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The format requirements of the Revisions to Existing Government Documents shall be the same format requirements as delineated in the basic Government document be revised.

children.title: The content requirements of the Revisions to Existing Government Documents shall be the same content requirements as delineated in the basic Government document being revised.
This DID should not be applied when the updating of an existing Government document requires a new format or additional content requirements.
The solicitation and contract must specifically identify (e.g., title, number, revision level, date, etc.) the existing Government document which is to be updated.
This DID may be applied in any solicitation or contract and during any acquisition phase.
